Subject: Re: Your Multi-Currency Billing Inquiry - Ticket CREWAISUP-1

Dear Customer,

Thank you for reaching out to us regarding multi-currency support on your dashboard billing. We understand how important it is to manage your financial data effectively across different currencies.

Our platform is designed to support multi-currency billing, allowing you to view and manage transactions in various currencies. Here’s a general guide on how you can typically access and understand your multi-currency data within your dashboard:

1.  **Navigate to Billing/Account Settings:** After logging into your account, please go to the 'Billing', 'Subscription', or 'Account Settings' section. This is usually found under your profile icon or a dedicated menu.
2.  **Locate Currency Display Options:** Within the billing area, look for options related to currency display. You might find a dropdown menu or a setting that allows you to select the currency in which you wish to view your reports, invoices, or transaction history.
3.  **Reviewing Multi-Currency Transactions:** When viewing individual transactions or reports, the system will typically show the original currency of the transaction. If a conversion has occurred or if you've selected a different display currency, both amounts might be shown, or the converted amount will be clearly indicated.
4.  **Generating Reports:** If you are generating financial reports, ensure you select the desired currency from the available options before exporting or viewing the report to ensure the data is presented in the currency you need.

If you are unable to locate these options, or if you have specific requirements for setting a default currency or enabling additional currencies for your account, please reply to this email with more details. Our team will be happy to assist you further with your specific setup.

We hope this information helps you navigate multi-currency support on your dashboard. Please do not hesitate to contact us if you have any further questions.

Best regards,

The [Your Company Name] Support Team
